annotations.title: Find member venues open to gig requests on a date

description: GigXchange MEMBER venues open to receiving a gig request on a specific date (free-by-default: open unless the venue marked that date). Use for "which venues could I pitch for Friday?". IMPORTANT: this is availability to RECEIVE A REQUEST TO PLAY — GigXchange does not currently support hiring a venue/room, and has no hire rates, so never present this as room hire. Filter by city. Paginated.

city.description: UK city/town to filter by. Omit for national.
